استهترت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْتَرْتُ (istahtartu) /is.tah.tar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# اِسْتَهْتَرْتَ (istahtarta) /is.tah.tar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# اِسْتَهْتَرْتِ (istahtarti) /is.tah.tar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# اِسْتَهْتَرَتْ (istahtarat) /is.t
